title.en: do not fill blank concrete pump specifications — B500S-83D does print 380 V — read beside “Capacity Regulating by Varying Speed”

description.en: do not fill blank concrete pump specifications at /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump. B500S-83D does print 380 V The horizontal cell is 25 m
description.zh: 邢台目录的空白格在订单上保持空白见 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump。水平格是 25 m。柴油60不印骨料粒径。

h1.en: Modulating Capacity at Constant Speed is the heading; do not fill blank concrete pump specifications stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「调节 能力 在 恒定转速」，主体仍是邢台目录的空白格在订单上保持空白

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for do not fill blank concrete pump specifications. The row to open is /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump. B500S-83D does print 380 V. The horizontal cell is 25 m. That voltage is printed on B500S-83D. Diesel 60 does not print aggregate size. LZ-80 prints that phrase for delivery height. Electric 10 Series does not print a vertical distance. Electric 15 does not print outlet pressure or hopper volume. HBT60-13.132 on Diesel 60 does not import LZ-60’s pipe or aggregate. HBT80-1816-110 on Electric 80 does not import HBT80-16’s 100 / 125 mm pipe. LZ-80 prints delivery height as “consult factory standard” rather than a metre number. The section title “Capacity Regulating by Varying Speed” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是邢台目录的空白格在订单上保持空白的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump。水平格是 25 m。柴油60不印骨料粒径。电动10系列不印垂直距离。电动15不印出口压力或料斗容积。该电压印在 B500S-83D 上。LZ-80 的输送高度印的就是这句话。B500S-83D 印了 380 V。LZ-80 的输送高度写成“咨询工厂标准”，而不是一个米数。柴油60上的 HBT60-13.132 不会带入 LZ-60 的管径或骨料。电动80上的 HBT80-1816-110 不会带入 HBT80-16 的 100 / 125 mm 管径。节标题「流量调节 通过 变速」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

heading.zh: 流量调节 通过 变速

body.en: “Capacity Regulating by Varying Speed” titles this part of the do not fill blank concrete pump specifications note. The figures stay the printed ones. B500S-83D does print 380 V. Diesel 60 does not print aggregate size. Electric 15 does not print outlet pressure or hopper volume. LZ-80 prints delivery height as “consult factory standard” rather than a metre number.
body.zh: 「流量调节 通过 变速」是邢台目录的空白格在订单上保持空白这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。B500S-83D 印了 380 V。柴油60上的 HBT60-13.132 不会带入 LZ-60 的管径或骨料。电动15不印出口压力或料斗容积。LZ-80 的输送高度写成“咨询工厂标准”，而不是一个米数。

heading.zh: 调节 能力 在 恒定转速

body.en: For do not fill blank concrete pump specifications, the heading “Modulating Capacity at Constant Speed” does not replace a cell. The horizontal cell is 25 m. LZ-80 prints that phrase for delivery height. HBT60-13.132 on Diesel 60 does not import LZ-60’s pipe or aggregate.
body.zh: 对邢台目录的空白格在订单上保持空白而言，标题「调节 能力 在 恒定转速」并不替换任何格子。水平格是 25 m。电动80上的 HBT80-1816-110 不会带入 HBT80-16 的 100 / 125 mm 管径。柴油60不印骨料粒径。

body.en: do not fill blank concrete pump specifications is unchanged by the heading “Pump Regulation and Power Consumption”. That voltage is printed on B500S-83D. Electric 10 Series does not print a vertical distance. HBT80-1816-110 on Electric 80 does not import HBT80-16’s 100 / 125 mm pipe. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pumps-discharge-regulation-d_310.html.
body.zh: 邢台目录的空白格在订单上保持空白不因标题「泵的调节与功率消耗」而改动。该电压印在 B500S-83D 上。电动10系列不印垂直距离。LZ-80 的输送高度印的就是这句话。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pumps-discharge-regulation-d_310.html。

question.en: Does “Capacity Regulating by Varying Speed” replace B500S-83D does print 380 V?
question.zh: 「流量调节 通过 变速」会替换「水平格是 25 m。」吗？

answer.en: No. B500S-83D does print 380 V remains the printed wording for do not fill blank concrete pump specifications.
answer.zh: 不会。水平格是 25 m。仍是邢台目录的空白格在订单上保持空白已印的说法。

question.en: Where does The horizontal cell is 25 m belong on the do not fill blank concrete pump specifications row?
question.zh: 邢台目录的空白格在订单上保持空白这一行里，「柴油60不印骨料粒径。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Modulating Capacity at Constant Speed” add to do not fill blank concrete pump specifications?
question.zh: 「调节 能力 在 恒定转速」给邢台目录的空白格在订单上保持空白增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pumps-discharge-regulation-d_310.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pumps-discharge-regulation-d_310.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
